column3: grep -E '\.(cpp|cc|cxx|c\+\+|hpp|hh|hxx|h|c)$' | perl -e 'while(defined(my $f=<STDIN>)){chomp $f; next unless -f $f && -r $f; open(my $h,"<",$f) or next; my @L=<$h>; close $h; chomp @L; my ($d,$pend,@stk)=(0,0); for my $i (0..$#L){ my $t=$L[$i]; $t=~s{//.*$}{}; $t=~s/(["\x27])(?:\\.|(?!\1).)*\1/_/g; if(@stk && $t=~/^\s*(public|private|protected)\s*:/){ $stk[-1][1]= $1 eq "public" ? 1 : 0 } elsif(@stk && $stk[-1][1] && $d==$stk[-1][0] && ($t=~/\bvoid\s+set[A-Z]\w*\s*\(/ || ($t!~/[()]/ && $t!~/\b(?:const|constexpr|static|mutable|typedef|using|friend|virtual|inline|explicit|template|enum|class|struct|union|operator|return)\b/ && $t=~/^\s*[A-Za-z_][\w:]*(?:\s*<[^;]*>)?(?:\s*[*&]+\s*|\s+)[A-Za-z_]\w*(?:\s*\[[^\]]*\])?\s*(?:=[^;]*|\{[^}]*\})?;\s*$/))){ print "$f:".($i+1).":$L[$i]\n" } $pend=($t=~/^\s*(?:template\s*<[^;]*>\s*)?(class|struct)\s+\w+(?:\s*:[^;{]*)?\s*\{?\s*$/) ? ($1 eq "struct" ? 2 : 1) : $pend; for my $c ($t=~/([{}])/g){ if($c eq "{"){ $d++; if($pend){ push @stk,[$d,$pend==2?1:0]; $pend=0 } } else { $d--; while(@stk && $stk[-1][0]>$d){ pop @stk } } } } }'
